notes: The version of record (NeuroImage 180:68-77, Comments and Controversies) is behind an Elsevier paywall; Crossref lists only the Elsevier text-and-data-mining user licences, which are not redistribution grants. Unpaywall reports is_oa true with a single open-access location, the arXiv preprint arXiv:1706.07581, which is what was read. Licence read directly from the abs-license block on https://arxiv.org/abs/1706.07581, which links http://arxiv.org/licenses/nonexclusive-distrib/1.0/ -- arXiv's default non-exclusive licence, conveying no third-party redistribution right. pdf_license is therefore unknown, redistribution_ok is false, and no PDF is committed; source.md is a markitdown conversion of https://arxiv.org/pdf/1706.07581 (935045 bytes), retained as internal research notes under fair use. The card cites the version of record and flags that the preprint (dated 26 June 2017) may differ from it in pagination, section numbering and any revision-time changes; one title-capitalisation difference was found. md_quality is rough: the two-column layout was serialised column-fragment by column-fragment inside bogus markdown tables, so most sentences are split by unrelated text from the other column, and inter-word spaces are frequently deleted. Figure 1, which carries the paper's central result, survives only as a scrambled list of percentages with panel-b axis labels interleaved into panel a; the panel assignments quoted on the card were reconstructed against the caption and are flagged as such. Figures 2 to 4 and A1 to A5 are image-only with captions surviving. Table 1 and Table A1 are broken across pseudo-table rows interleaved with figure captions, and the Appendix D standard-error table is scattered across loose cells and required reconstruction. The reference list is intact; there are no equations. Where the extraction and the body prose disagreed, the prose was taken -- notably for the Figure 3 vibration-effect score ranges, where the card quotes the text's 44-52 percent, up to 57 percent, up to 71 percent rather than the reconstructed panel values. EXTRACTION UPDATE 2026-08-01 -- source.md was regenerated with pymupdf4llm, which preserves markdown tables and inter-word spacing that the earlier markitdown conversion destroyed, and md_quality was reassessed against the new extraction as clean (was rough). The PDF used for that extraction is cached locally as source.local.pdf, which is gitignored and deliberately not committed because the licence forbids redistribution.
